yt_description:
Prepare for pure algorithmic absurdity! 🤯 We dive into Bogo Sort, also known as 'stupid sort' or 'permutation sort.' Witness the sheer, unadulterated randomness as this algorithm *tries* to sort data by repeatedly shuffling it until it's (by pure chance) in order. Is this the worst sorting algorithm in existence? Probably! 😂 Watch for the hilarious visualization and understand WHY you should NEVER use Bogo Sort in real life.
